soundness_flags.label: ass:uniform-multiplier-law / oeq:uniform-changing-support
soundness_flags.one_line: The expression \(\sup_{\mathbb P\in\mathfrak P_{\kappa}}|E_{\mathbb P}^\star f(G_n^\star)-Ef(G_{\mathbb P,n})|\to_P0\) has no governing probability law after the supremum ranges over distinct experiments; state uniform convergence explicitly, e.g. \(\sup_{\mathbb P}P_{\mathbb P}\{\sup_{\|f\|_{BL}\le1}|\cdot|>\varepsilon\}\to0\).

accepted_scope_caveats.label: oeq:uniform-changing-support
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: Uniform primitive Gaussian approximation and uniform conditional multiplier approximation are assumed inputs, not results of the proposed kernel.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: Any resulting paired-envelope coverage theorem is conditional on those two primitive uniform approximations, plus a feasible jointly specified \(t_n,\kappa_n\) regime.

source_verification_receipts.locator: Proceedings record, abstract and bibliographic record, lines 8--25
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper introduces projected abstractions for lossy representations, constructs them from a low-level model, and translates observational, interventional, and counterfactual queries.

source_verification_receipts.locator: Author-hosted publication text: pp. 1--2 abstract and introduction; Section 3.1, Theorem 3.1; Section 3 uniformity theorem
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The numerical derivative method gives pointwise consistency under directional differentiability and also develops uniform validity for specified convex/Lipschitz classes.
The paper gives pointwise LP-value inference and uniform consistency under its polytope delta-condition, while stating uniform inference as future work.

The article studies unlinked datasets and uses optimal transport to constructively characterize a sharp identified set; the proposal bibliography should correct its cited pagination from 1462--1500 to 238--267.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Replace the ambiguous uniform-multiplier display with a uniform-in-experiment probability statement, and explicitly state the nonempty compatibility requirements linking \(t_n\) and \(\kappa_n\).

Make the field kernel a sharp threshold or matching failure construction for \(\kappa_n\), explicitly distinguishing it from Hong--Li's convex/Lipschitz uniform theorem and Voronin's delta-conditioned uniform consistency.
Correct the D'Haultfœuille--Gaillac--Maurel citation to Review of Economic Studies 92(1):238--267 and add a pinpointed theorem/section anchor for the sharp-transport comparison.

recommended_next_step: Repair the uniform conditional-resampling assumption, retain the uniform changing-support question as the conditional field-level kernel, and then advance the repaired proposal to Stage 0.
